title: Add TaskStatuses.All and TaskPriorities.All validation sets
description:
P0: `TaskDomainService.NormalizeOrDefault` only trims/null-checks status/priority/type values — no membership validation against defined constant sets. `TaskStatuses` and `TaskPriorities` have no `All` `HashSet` at all (contrast with `MaintenanceProposalStatuses.All` which exists but is unused). A task created or updated with a typo'd status (e.g. `"Cancelled"` instead of `Rejected`, or `"In Progress"` with a space) via the REST/MCP API silently vanishes from every Kanban column query, which does an exact `OrdinalIgnoreCase` match.

Scope:
- Add `TaskStatuses.All` and `TaskPriorities.All` `HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)`
- Validate in `NormalizeOrDefault` call sites for Status/Priority/Type — reject with clear error naming valid options, or fall back with warning
- Add similar validation to `SetStatusAsync`

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-9-20260702.md §1, council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 6-seat council audit synthesis. Data Model Architect rated at 88% confidence. Open question: does the Blazor task-board UI query per-column or fetch-all-and-bucket-client-side? Determines invisible vs miscategorized tasks.
